Convection.sig: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning spells by #%.

Concussion.sig: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by #%.

Elemental Devastation.t: Spell crits give +{1}% melee crit for {2} sec
Elemental Devastation.sig: Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by #% for # sec.

Reverberation.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by # sec.

Elemental Alacrity.t: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning {1} sec faster
Elemental Alacrity.sig: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by # sec.

Call of Flame.t: Fire totems, Flame Shock and Fire Nova +{1}%, Flame Shock {2} sec longer
Call of Flame.sig: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by #%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by # sec.

Elemental Focus.t: {1}% chance your next damage spell is cheaper
Elemental Focus.sig: Gives you a #% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by #%.

Elemental Warding.t: {1}% less Fire, Frost and Nature damage taken
Elemental Warding.sig: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by #%.

Trial by Fire.t: Fire Nova +{1}% and {2} sec shorter cooldown, Magma Totem lasts longer
Trial by Fire.sig: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by #% and reduces its cooldown by # sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by # sec.

Eye of the Storm.t: {1}% chance to ignore pushback on Lightning
Eye of the Storm.sig: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Earthbound.t: Earthbind Totem roots for {1} sec when placed
Earthbound.sig: Your Earthbind Totem Immobilizes nearby targets for # sec when cast.

Elemental Reach.t: Lightning and Fire Nova reach {1} yards farther
Elemental Reach.sig: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Fire Nova spells by # yards.

Call of Thunder.sig: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by #%.

Lightning Overload.t: {1}% chance Lightning casts a free half-damage copy
Lightning Overload.sig: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a #% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

Elemental Fury.t: +{1}% crit damage on spells and fire totems
Elemental Fury.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by #%.

Lightning Mastery.t: Faster Lightning Bolt and no Chain Lightning cooldown for {2} sec
Lightning Mastery.sig: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by # sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts # sec.

Earth's Grasp.sig: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by #% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by #%.

Thundering Strikes.sig: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by #%.

Guardian Totems.t: Stoneskin and Windwall +{1}%, Grounding cooldown {2} sec shorter
Guardian Totems.sig: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by #% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by # sec.

Mental Dexterity.sig: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to #% of your Intellect.

Improved Lightning Shield.sig: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by #%.

Elemental Weapons.sig: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by #%, your Windfury Weapon effect by #% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by #%.

Shamanistic Focus.sig: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by #%.

Anticipation.sig: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional #%.

Flurry.t: +{1}% attack speed for {2} swings after a crit
Flurry.sig: Increases your attack speed by #% for your next # swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

Stormstrike.t: {1}% weapon hit, next Lightning or Earth Shock +{2}%
Stormstrike.sig: Instantly strike for #% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by #% for # sec.

Improved Ghost Wolf.t: Ghost Wolf {1} sec faster and works indoors
Improved Ghost Wolf.sig: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by # sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

Spirit Weapons.t: Can parry, threat changes with Rockbiter
Spirit Weapons.sig: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by #% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by #% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

Mental Quickness.sig: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to #% of your Intellect.

Improved Stormstrike.t: Stormstrike gives mana regen while casting and can reset
Improved Stormstrike.sig: When you Stormstrike, you have a #% chance to gain #% mana regeneration while casting spells for # sec, and Stormstrike's cooldown has a #% chance to reset each time you Dodge or Parry.

Maelstrom Weapon.t: Hits make your next Lightning Bolt {1}% faster and cheaper per stack, up to {2} stacks
Maelstrom Weapon.sig: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by #%. Stacks up to # times. Lasts # sec. Activates about # times per minute.

Rage of the Farseer.sig: Increases your attack speed by #% for # sec.

Improved Healing Wave.sig: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by # sec.

Tidal Focus.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by #% and improves your chance to hit by #%.

Mindfulness.sig: Allows #% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Natural Grace.sig: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by #%.

Totemic Focus.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by #%.

Improved Reincarnation.sig: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by # min, increases your maximum health by #%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional #%.

Ancestral Healing.t: Heal crits give +{1}% armor for {2} sec
Ancestral Healing.sig: Increases your target's armor value by #% for # sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

Healing Focus.t: {1}% chance to ignore pushback on heals
Healing Focus.sig: Gives your healing spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Water Shield.t: Water globes restore {2}% mana when hit
Water Shield.sig: The caster is surrounded by # globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, #% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts # min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

Tidal Mastery.sig: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by #%.

Restorative Totems.sig: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by #% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by #%.

Mana Tide Totem.t: Totem that restores mana to your group
Mana Tide Totem.sig: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with # health at the feet of the caster for # sec that restores # mana every # seconds to group members within # yards.

Healing Way.sig: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by #%.

Nature's Swiftness.sig: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than # sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

Purification.sig: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by #%.

Riptide.t: Heal over time, next Chain Heal on the target +{3}%
Riptide.sig: Heals a friendly target for # over # sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by #%.
